source_title: Arizona Secretary of State — 2024 official U.S. Senate canvass
source_notes: 2024 regular Arizona U.S. Senate election. All 10 official named candidates, including write-ins, and all 15 county records reconcile to the printed statewide canvass totals. The official PDF host returned 403; retained indexed official table text and a reviewed CSV provide the canvass reference. Checksums identify retained text/CSV, not an unavailable original PDF binary. Official page-1 eligible registration, ballots and published turnout retained.
turnout_definition: Official canvass turnout: total ballots cast / total eligible registration; published rounded percentage retained.

secondary_acquisition.role: Corroboration only; official canvass supplies all actual candidates and votes
